title: GovCERT.HK alert: vulnerability in F5 NGINX products could lead to denial of service; updates and mitigations available
date_note: Date is GovCERT.HK's alert day (24 November 2026); the page gives no earlier day.
summary: GovCERT.HK's alert says a vulnerability in F5 NGINX products affects NGINX Open Source 1.21.4 to 1.29.8, 1.30.0 to 1.30.7 and 1.31.0 to 1.31.9, plus NGINX Plus, Ingress Controller, Gateway Fabric and WAF products. It says successful exploitation could lead to denial of service. The alert says software updates and mitigations are available and points to F5 advisory K000163947; it does not say the flaw is exploited.
plain: Hong Kong's government CERT warns that several F5 NGINX products have a flaw that could let an attacker crash a system. It says updates are available.
exec: GovCERT.HK says the flaw could cause denial of service on affected NGINX systems; fixes and mitigations are available.
action: GovCERT.HK advises administrators to follow the vendor's recommendations and act immediately to mitigate the risk; the vendor advisory is F5 K000163947.

validation.note: Read GovCERT.HK alert A26-11-57 only; F5's advisory K000163947 was not read. The alert's reference links include CVE-2026-132779 but the text does not name it as this flaw's identifier, so no CVE is recorded.

review.note: evidence quote did not match page wording (page: 'NGINX Open Source versions 1.21.4 - 1.29.8, ...'); quote fixed, rest matches the alert
